text:
Ivy (Events): Quick thread to lock topic + abstracts for May webinar. Need a final pick and speaker confirmations by EOD. Short replies please.

Rohan (Producer): Runtime target 40m (5m intro, 20m demo/case, 10m panel, 5m CTA/Q follow-ups). Green room 20m prior.

Jules (Content): Two abstract options: A) "Practical cost-first inference: real-world savings and config snippets" B) "Scaling inference: rolling safe model variants and evals". A is tighter for marketing; B resonates with platform teams.

Priya (Host): Leaning A. Hook suggestion: one-line stat up front (e.g., "Cut per-inference cost by 30% with these ops patterns"). Also want a 15s fallback line if demo slow.

Eli (Speaker): I can present A. Will include before/after benchmark slides and a 1-page rollout checklist. Confirming mic + camera availability.

Ivy (Events): Noted. Please upload slides by Tue noon. Rohan, schedule two mic-check slots (one for host, one for speaker). OpsBot: set reminder for green room 20m prior -> 1769235489.

Rohan (Producer): Mic-checks: 18:20 host, 18:30 speaker. Rehearsal run order: 1) host intro (90s) 2) speaker demo (15-20m) 3) short panel QA (10m) 4) CTA + next steps (3m). If demo fails, cut to prerecorded 2m clip at assets/fallbacks/demo_short.mp4 and host reads fallback line.

Jules (Content): Abstract v1 posted in doc: "Learn the exact batching, KV caching, and quantization knobs used to reduce token costs by 25-40%. Includes benchmark tables and rollout checklist." I'll tighten the CTA and add a suggested tweet.

Priya (Host): I'll handle audience Q triage; Eli will answer technical Qs; marketing will capture MQLs in private #webinar-1769-leads.

Eli (Speaker): :thumbsup: I'll join green room 30m early for slides review. Slides ETA: tonight.

Ivy (Events): Great. Last asks: captions on, recording enabled, and eng-runtime on standby for live demo. If any blocker, notify Rohan first. Thanks all.
